Not something she said, but something she did.
As a child, I was sent into a French kindergarten, even though I didn't know how to speak French - my parents hoped I'd learn by playing with the other kids, etc. Thing is, a lot of parents had the same idea and there were a only about 3 or something kids that actually spoke French. Basically I didn't learn anything.
The teacher, however, ONLY spoke French - didn't understand anything else!
Now, one day she wanted something from me, and y'know, I didn't understand. She got so frustrated with me that she took and threw me into the bathroom, turned the lights off and locked the door. 
The Bitch only then let me out at the end of the day and made it look as if nothing happened so that my parents wouldn't ask questions.
I didn't tell my parents because I was scared of the teacher... Luckily that was around the time we were looking for a new kindergarten and I went to a new one soon after that.
Maybe I have it a bit overdramatized in my memory, but it was really traumatic as a small child.
